listing.name: BLACK (Xbox) (BLACK-XBERecomp)
listing.summary: An original-Xbox BLACK implementation separate from Spark198rus’s black-pc. Its Windows 10+ x86-64 Direct3D 12 package compiles game code locally on first start. Use your own USA or Europe ISO or complete extracted data in assets/. The separate manual source build specifically needs the USA default.xbe and matching data; this guide does not specify exact per-region executable hashes. Linux and macOS player routes are unconfirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay. Choose BLACK.exe after setup finishes.
